title: Connect DDs and selected utilities to real dataset effects
digest_scope: Recursively lexicographically key-sorted compact UTF-8 JSON serialization of utility_receipt, with no trailing newline, followed by SHA-256
acceptance_observations: Dataset-backed DDs allocate, hydrate, and write through typed host effects. DISP normal/abnormal positions, temporary PASS/delete identity, PDS members, concatenations, relative generations, and parsed DSORG/RECFM/LRECL allocation attributes are preserved without a native fallback.

Reached IDCAMS DELETE, DEFINE CLUSTER/GDG/AIX/PATH, REPRO, LISTCAT, and BLDINDEX statements validate before mutation. IEBGENER, SORT, and IEFBR14 produce exact dataset, spool, GDG, AIX, RRDS, and lifecycle state through bounded effect sequences.

The public z/OSMF contract accepts Zowe CLI job lookup with owner wildcard constrained to the authenticated principal, job-id filtering, complete spool identities, inclusive dataset starts, attribute-bearing PDS discovery, CRLF text upload, and member upload. Actual ESDSRRDS, DEFGDGD, and INTRDRJ1 corpus jobs completed CC 0000 through Zowe 8.36.0; the internal reader queued INTRDRJ2.

Reached SDSF, FTP, and IKJEFT1B programs have explicit external-service dispositions and fail Unsupported before generic program dispatch. Unknown utility names and unknown IDCAMS controls cannot return success or partially mutate state.
